name: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data)
desc: Real-time disaggregated event data on battles, violence, and protests across all 54 African states.

name: ACLED Conflict in the Sahel
desc: ACLED's dedicated Sahel hub tracking JNIM, IS Sahel and state violence in Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.

name: Ethiopia Peace Observatory (ACLED)
desc: ACLED project tracking Tigray, Amhara/Fano, Oromia and other Ethiopian conflicts with maps and updates.

name: Mozambique Conflict Monitor (Cabo Ligado)
desc: ACLED/Zitamar/Mediacoop observatory tracking the IS Mozambique insurgency in Cabo Delgado.

name: Sudan War Monitor
desc: OSINT analysis, maps and verified footage of the SAF-RSF civil war; geolocation and satellite work.

name: Nigeria Security Tracker (CFR)
desc: CFR map and dataset of Nigerian political violence; archival baseline for Boko Haram/ISWAP incidents.

name: HumAngle Media
desc: Conflict newsroom on Lake Chad Basin, NE Nigeria and the Sahel; runs the HumAngle Security Tracker.

name: FDD's Long War Journal
desc: FDD coverage of al-Shabaab, ISWAP, JNIM and IS jihadist activity across Africa with maps and analysis.

name: International Crisis Group - CrisisWatch (Africa)
desc: Monthly early-warning conflict tracker covering 70+ situations with dedicated Africa and Sahel records.

name: Institute for Security Studies (ISS Africa)
desc: Leading pan-African security think-tank: ISS Today analysis on conflict, terrorism and organised crime.

name: Hiraal Institute
desc: Somali security think-tank publishing al-Shabaab analysis, incident data and control/influence maps.

name: Africa Center for Strategic Studies
desc: US DoD academic center; annual militant-Islamist threat data and analysis spanning Sahel to Somalia.

name: Critical Threats Project - Congo War Security Review
desc: AEI mapping and review of the eastern DRC war between M23/Rwanda and pro-government forces.

name: IPIS Research - Maps of DRC
desc: Interactive maps of armed-group presence, M23 territorial control and mining sites in eastern Congo.

name: Menastream
desc: Specialist consultancy (Heni Nsaibia) tracking JNIM and IS Sahel armed actors and jihadist propaganda.

name: Sahel Liveuamap
desc: Live crowdsourced incident map of militant and military activity across Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso, Chad.

name: West Africa Maps (Wamaps)
desc: Francophone cartographic monitoring and analysis of security incidents across the Sahel and West Africa.

name: Hudson / CFR Global Conflict Tracker - Violent Extremism in the Sahel
desc: CFR Global Conflict Tracker entry summarising drivers, actors and status of the Sahel jihadist crisis.
